hypothesis: Duplex formation/persistence depends on genomic organization and compatible transcript processing
missing_from_adaredit: Pair gap, repeat subfamily/divergence/neighborhood, transcript compatibility and splice geometry are not uniquely recoverable from the folded graph
data_source: Pair BED; UCSC RepeatMasker hg38; GENCODE v46
advance_rule: Site-wise broad residual failed, but nine genomic-geometry variables predict pair edited fraction far better than graph-intrinsic summaries in every tissue; actual Alu-arm gap has Spearman -0.33 to -0.48 with pair edited fraction
kill_rule: Terminate broad site-wise panel; test genomic geometry only through the hierarchical substrate-engagement formulation

hypothesis: The balanced canonical subset discards tens of thousands of valid high/low training sites even though the pair boundary already prevents leakage
missing_from_adaredit: Current per-tissue canonical training sees only the balanced sample rather than every eligible high-confidence site on training pairs
data_source: Raw GTEx editing tables restricted to development pairs; equal high/low pair-first stochastic sampling with canonical-sized epoch budget
effective_power: 508-705 development pairs across all five endpoints
advance_rule: Pair-balanced training improves AUROC/AUPRC/F1 in Muscle (+0.0429/+0.0475/+0.0425), Liver (+0.0180/+0.0170/+0.0164), Artery (+0.0123/+0.0138/+0.0070), Brain (+0.0118/+0.0163/+0.0112) and Combined (+0.0147/+0.0170/+0.0143) under identical folds; all ranking and F1 intervals exclude zero
kill_rule: Preserve the exact pair-first sampler and canonical per-epoch update budget as the shared training component of the frozen successor

hypothesis: Intermediate and continuous EditingIndex teach a smoother chemical/engagement representation
missing_from_adaredit: Canonical binary training discards 1-15% and continuous levels
data_source: Raw GTEx editing tables on development pairs
advance_rule: Standalone pair-balanced multi-task adds AUROC +0.0081 but only F1 +0.0008 over pair-balanced binary. A three-way fixed stack adds only +0.0032 F1 over pair plus focal with an interval crossing zero; at natural prevalence it loses F1 -0.0048 with a negative interval and worsens Brier
kill_rule: Terminate loss tuning and exclude multitask from the primary successor; retain artifacts only as a secondary ranking result

hypothesis: A shared intrinsic encoder can learn from far more high/low observations while tissue-specific heads retain realized-context differences
missing_from_adaredit: Per-tissue canonical training discards raw sites and cannot transfer intrinsic rules across contexts; the published joint model already benefits data-limited Muscle/Liver
data_source: All raw development high/low rows from four individual tissues; no Combined
effective_power: 659 observed global development pairs; 60037 canonical site-tissue rows
advance_rule: Versus independently trained pair-balanced models, joint-minus-independent macro differences are AUROC +0.0087, AUPRC +0.0116 and F1 +0.0075; global-pair bootstrap intervals are positive, but macro F1 and AUROC both miss the frozen +0.01 promotion gate and mean Brier worsens +0.0043
kill_rule: Retain as a secondary transfer result; do not build a joint-local model after the preregistered advancement gate failed

hypothesis: A site's intrinsic-editability rank relative to every other A on its duplex measures substrate-relative opportunity without using outcome labels
missing_from_adaredit: Independent classification never asks whether the focal site is exceptional relative to the rest of the same substrate
data_source: Fold-held-out GAT predictions for every A in each development duplex
advance_rule: Relative rank improved the weak original-reference residual, but an outer-isolated gate on the leading pair-balanced model added only median +0.0011 AUROC and +0.0023 F1 beyond recalibration; it did not beat within-pair shuffled rank on AUPRC/F1
kill_rule: Do not integrate into the successor; revisit only if a genuinely joint substrate model yields rank without a post-hoc gate

hypothesis: Sites on one duplex share a substrate engagement state
missing_from_adaredit: Independent site classification has no explicit shared latent or burden objective
data_source: All candidate A sites and continuous levels per development substrate
advance_rule: The direct joint decoder lost -0.0664 AUROC/-0.0673 AUPRC/-0.0599 F1 versus pair-balanced training over two completed folds, with negative intervals. Cross-fitted focal rank was also null beyond pair-balanced training
kill_rule: Reopen only with genuinely new substrate-state measurements or substantially more independent substrates; do not enlarge the same latent model

hypothesis: Local bulges and helix continuity within ADAR contact windows alter site chemistry and engagement
missing_from_adaredit: The three-layer pooled GAT and whole-duplex Bio-aware CNN do not explicitly retain target-centered patterns beyond their local receptive field
data_source: Dot-bracket helix alignment and prespecified +/-5/10/20/32 nt contact summaries; Song et al. Cell 2026
advance_rule: Target-geometry residual internal median delta AUROC +0.0107 (95% CI +0.0048,+0.0162), AUPRC +0.0139 (+0.0070,+0.0215), and Brier -0.0070; thresholded F1 +0.0018 CI crosses zero while recall rises and specificity falls
kill_rule: Advance target/partner-aligned local CNN only after richer-supervision controls; terminate if integrated gain is absent or capacity controls match it

hypothesis: The compact GAT computes a focal-node representation but global mean pooling can dilute it across a long duplex
missing_from_adaredit: AdarEdit marks the target and relative position at every node but does not expose the final focal-node embedding directly to the classifier
data_source: Existing graph; concatenate final focal-node embedding with the unchanged whole-graph mean embedding
advance_rule: Muscle focal versus pair: AUROC +0.0126 and AUPRC +0.0169 with positive intervals. Liver focal replicates ranking; the fixed pair-plus-focal ensemble adds AUROC +0.0139, AUPRC +0.0210 and F1 +0.0130 versus Liver pair-balanced, with all intervals positive and favorable natural-prevalence transport
kill_rule: Do not advance focal alone because standalone F1 intervals cross zero; retain as the validated fallback ensemble if the higher-priority local ladder fails

hypothesis: A three-layer message-passing/global-pooling encoder may underresolve target-centered motifs beyond its local receptive field
missing_from_adaredit: Explicit target-centered +/-32 nt sequence/pairing representation complements rather than replaces the whole RNA graph

hypothesis: H3K36me3/H2A.Z and accessibility modulate editing upstream of RNA structure

hypothesis: Masked sequence/structure or contrastive pretraining on many nonbenchmark inverted-Alu substrates learns duplex priors before scarce supervised fine-tuning
missing_from_adaredit: The current encoder learns all RNA representations from only hundreds of labeled independent pairs

A validated target-local successor has emerged, so pretraining is deferred beyond this frozen benchmark campaign
